name: Tomer Cohen
biography: Tomer Cohen leads the team at Wix.com responsible for all R&D and production systems security. Previous to that, Tomer has worked as an application security expert in several firms. Tomer was also one of the founders of "Magshimim" cyber training program, which teaches development and cyber security among high-school students in the periphery of Israel.
